rationale: Spectr reproduced a native abort after malformed UTF-8 reached Pulp's transferred text-shaping kernel and produced an invalid glyph count followed by a huge allocation request. Pulp must carry the bounded repair immediately to unblock a crash-free plug-in release: validate UTF-8 before shaping and replace malformed sequences with U+FFFD, including overlong three-byte and four-byte encodings. The change adds no public API and expires within fourteen days while Vellum issue #27 ports the generic repair to the authoritative framework.
